# 1.31.0 — Settings rebuilt, a lighter start

Settings, keys and conversations from earlier versions are read as they are. No setting was
removed: every one keeps its value and only moved to a page where it belongs.

## Settings, rearranged

- **Eleven pages in three groups**, each with its own icon on a colored tile: *General*,
  *Appearance*, *Profile* · *Models*, *Prompts*, *Instructions*, *Automation* · *Security*,
  *Keys & spending*, *Data*, *About*. In the Russian interface the pages and their titles are
  in Russian now as well.
- **Every group of options sits in a card**, page titles are larger, and the Settings window is
  a little wider (720 × 520) so labels next to two dropdowns no longer get cut off. Long lists
  open as sub-pages with a back arrow, and the row that leads there shows what is set inside —
  "Tray", "Default", "Gradient", "All enabled".
- **Where things moved:**
  - *General* (was Behavior) — language and date format, notifications, chat and window;
    *Keyboard shortcuts*, *Windows integration* and *Voice input* are sub-pages.
  - *Appearance* — *Theme* and *Background and accent* are sub-pages; interface options; the
    compact input box, whose settings now dim together with its switch.
  - *Profile* (was Account) — profile, picture and name; *Password and lock*, where auto-lock and
    *Lock now* moved from Security — they only work with a password.
  - *Models* — chat answers, agent and service tasks (titles, summary, web search), formerly the
    top of Customize.
  - *Prompts* — the main prompt and the preset library; the technical prompts are a sub-page.
  - *Security* — access mode; **SynGuard and its model** (moved from Customize); plan before
    changes; encryption; *Tools* and *Download sources* (moved from Data) are sub-pages.
  - *Keys & spending* (was Key & Info) — balance, spending, keys and limits.
  - *Data* (was Data Controls) — chats, transfer and backups, and the irreversible actions at the
    end. **Disk usage** is now at the top of *Storage and cleanup* and is counted only when you
    open it, instead of reading every chat file each time you visit Data.
  - *About* — version and updates (moved from Data), the *Getting started* guide (was the Info
    page) and help: documentation, repository, bug report, logs.

## Main window

- **PC health and the journal moved into the title bar.** Their buttons used to float over the
  conversation and cover the first message.
- The right edge of messages now lines up with the input box.
- Three icons under an answer that could never be used (Compress, Expand, Edit) are gone; the
  five working ones remain.
- PC health shows its sections in the same cards as Settings.

## A lighter start

- **Settings are no longer built together with the window.** Their markup was more than half of
  what the window parsed before it could appear. Now the pages are built after the first frame,
  one at a time while the program is idle, and opening Settings before that builds only the page
  you open. In our startup benchmark with 300 chats, creating the window went from 0.83 s to
  0.47 s on a cold start and from about 0.4 s to 0.12 s on a warm one, and the first frame
  arrives about 0.3 s sooner.
- The heaviest parts of Settings wait until they are needed: the model picker panels until you
  open a model field, the 53 theme cards and the shortcut rows until you open their sub-page.
